hook.name: ParadygmHook
hook.description: A tax hook for the $PARADYGM token that deducts a configurable buy/sell tax (up to 25% each) from every swap via afterSwap. It returns a positive delta on the unspecified currency to reduce the swapper's output, then calls poolManager.take() to transfer the fee to a treasury address. Tax rates and treasury are settable by an owner who can optionally renounce control.
